description: Bitwise AND of two voltages, in two independent sections; each voltage is multiplied by 10,000 and truncated to a whole number, the bits are combined, and the result is divided by 10,000 again

inputs.text: One of the two voltages combined by the AND in its own section

outputs.text: The bitwise AND of the two inputs of its section, at 1/10,000 resolution

notes: the two sections are separate; neither input of one reaches the other
